title: decision block props
description: A choice in a scenario. Consequences are defined by events (decision.selected with option), for example show a layer or go to another screen. Use it for branching scenarios (guardrail B3).
x-ai-instructions: Realistic situation, plausible options, consequences shown rather than told (D3). Add one event per option or one event per outcome.

feedback.description: Optional inline consequence shown after the choice.

correct.description: Optional: marks the best choice for tracking and scoring.

scored.description: Counts in the course score (needs at least one option with correct).

allowChange.description: Let the learner choose again after seeing the consequence.
